name: Multilingual starter
description: Prepare a site for two languages: language inventory, per-post language assignment, translation linking, and a duplicated menu structure check.

params.name: source_posts
params.description: Post ids to prepare for translation.

steps.title: Survey
steps.detail: Call wp_get_site_info and wp_list_posts (per_page=100) to understand the current language mix and which plugin (WPML/Polylang) is installed.

steps.title: Assign languages
steps.detail: For each id in <source_posts>, call wp_set_post_language with the correct locale.

steps.title: Link translations
steps.detail: After the owner (or the agent in a second pass) creates the translated counterparts with wp_create_post, call wp_link_post_translation to bind source and translation.

steps.title: Menus
steps.detail: Call wp_list_menus and report whether each language has a menu; propose the structure but create menus only on confirmation (wp_create_menu + wp_add_menu_item).

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver: language assignments, translation pairs linked, menu gaps, and the list of posts still needing translation.

guardrails: Never delete the source post when linking a translation.
Translations are created as drafts; publishing is the owner's call.
